summary: PowerShell scripts are excellent (Set-StrictMode, [CmdletBinding()], proper error handling, pure testable functions). Workflow follows GitHub Actions best practices (pinned actions, least-privilege permissions, shell: pwsh). Critical gaps: (1) No act-result.txt artifact creation (required by task); (2) Workflow references test files and fixtures without creating or validating them exist; (3) Missing integration test harness to run multiple 'act push' invocations as required; (4) Incomplete 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT' requirement. Recommend: seed fixture files, create external test harness that runs act and validates outputs, ensure workflow validates file existence upfront.
